Equity in practice · How the system connects

Plan a legislatively required working group

When the Legislature creates a working group or task force, the law sets its purpose, members, meetings, duties and report date. This page turns that charge into a month-by-month plan, using the Waiver Case Management Advisory Working Group as the worked example, and shows how to reuse the plan for another group.

The charge below is quoted from the law. The workplan, topic method, recommendation record and checkpoints are proposed practice for confirmation by the group and the department, not statutory requirements. Checked on {WORKING_GROUP_PLAN_CHECKED}.
